result.instructions: Tools for MemberRun, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which members have an expiry date in the next 30 days?"; "List the registrations for our annual conference and show who is on the waitlist."; "Create a member for jane@example.org with the role member and status active.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes MemberRun data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run memberrun_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run memberrun_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run memberrun_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. memberrun_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: memberrun_get_account
tools.title: Get the API key and association
tools.description: Show the association this key belongs to, its name and the key's scopes. Good first call to confirm the connection. API: GET /me.

annotations.title: Get the API key and association

tools.name: memberrun_list_members
tools.title: List members
tools.description: List the association's members, filtered by status, role or email. Returns a page with has_more and next_cursor. API: GET /members.

starting_after.description: Cursor: the id of the last object on the previous page (next_cursor).

tools.name: memberrun_get_member
tools.title: Get a member
tools.description: Get one member by id, with status, role, expiry and profile. API: GET /members/{id}.

member_id.description: The id, as returned by the list or create tools.

tools.name: memberrun_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: List events (conferences, webinars, workshops and so on), filtered by status and start date. API: GET /events.

start_after.description: Only events starting after this date.

start_before.description: Only events starting before this date.

starting_after.description: Cursor: the id of the last object on the previous page (next_cursor).

tools.name: memberrun_get_event
tools.title: Get an event
tools.description: Get one event by id, with dates, location, capacity, prices and status. API: GET /events/{id}.

event_id.description: The id, as returned by the list or create tools.

tools.name: memberrun_list_event_registrations
tools.title: List event registrations
tools.description: List registrations, filtered by event, member or status (registered, waitlisted, attended, cancelled). API: GET /event_registrations.

event_id.description: Only registrations for this event id.

member_id.description: Only registrations for this member id.

starting_after.description: Cursor: the id of the last object on the previous page (next_cursor).

tools.name: memberrun_get_event_registration
tools.title: Get an event registration
tools.description: Get one registration by id, with its status, payment status and attendance time. API: GET /event_registrations/{id}.

registration_id.description: The id, as returned by the list or create tools.

tools.name: memberrun_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List invoices (read only), filtered by status, member or household. Refunds and new invoices are not possible here. API: GET /invoices.

member_id.description: Only invoices for this member id.

household_id.description: Only invoices for this household id.

starting_after.description: Cursor: the id of the last object on the previous page (next_cursor).

tools.name: memberrun_get_invoice
tools.title: Get an invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice by id, with amount, currency, due date and paid date. API: GET /invoices/{id}.

invoice_id.description: The id, as returned by the list or create tools.

tools.name: memberrun_list_resources
tools.title: List resources
tools.description: List library resources (courses, webinars, articles, templates, guides, toolkits), filtered by status or type. Read only. API: GET /resources.

starting_after.description: Cursor: the id of the last object on the previous page (next_cursor).

tools.name: memberrun_get_resource
tools.title: Get a resource
tools.description: Get one library resource by id. Read only. API: GET /resources/{id}.

resource_id.description: The id, as returned by the list or create tools.

tools.name: memberrun_list_chapters
tools.title: List chapters
tools.description: List the association's regional or topic chapters, optionally only active ones. Read only. API: GET /chapters.

starting_after.description: Cursor: the id of the last object on the previous page (next_cursor).

tools.name: memberrun_get_chapter
tools.title: Get a chapter
tools.description: Get one chapter by id, with name, region and active flag. Read only. API: GET /chapters/{id}.

chapter_id.description: The id, as returned by the list or create tools.

tools.name: memberrun_create_member
tools.title: Create a member
tools.description: Create a membership for an email address and change real records. If the person already has a membership here, the API returns 400. API: POST /members.

role.description: Membership role. The API never grants admin access.

profile.description: Profile fields (title, company, location, designation, bio, phone, linkedin_url, specializations).

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Reuse the same key only to retry the same create; the API then returns the first answer.

tools.name: memberrun_update_member
tools.title: Update a member
tools.description: Change a member's name, role, status, expiry or profile. Only the fields you send change. Set status to expired to archive. API: PATCH /members/{id}.

member_id.description: The id, as returned by the list or create tools.

role.description: Membership role. The API never grants admin access.

profile.description: Profile fields (title, company, location, designation, bio, phone, linkedin_url, specializations).

tools.name: memberrun_suspend_member
tools.title: Suspend a member
tools.description: Suspend a member (soft delete: the status becomes suspended and nothing is erased). Members with admin access cannot be changed through the API. API: DELETE /members/{id}.

member_id.description: The id, as returned by the list or create tools.

tools.name: memberrun_create_event
tools.title: Create an event
tools.description: Create an event with a title, type, start time and optional prices and capacity. Prices are whole cents. Creates a real record. API: POST /events.

type.description: conference, webinar, workshop, networking, agm or general.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Reuse the same key only to retry the same create; the API then returns the first answer.

tools.name: memberrun_update_event
tools.title: Update an event
tools.description: Change an event's fields or status. Only the fields you send change. To cancel, prefer memberrun_cancel_event. API: PATCH /events/{id}.

event_id.description: The id, as returned by the list or create tools.

tools.name: memberrun_cancel_event
tools.title: Cancel an event
tools.description: Cancel an event (soft: the status becomes cancelled). This emails everyone registered and removes a linked Zoom meeting where it can. API: DELETE /events/{id}.

event_id.description: The id, as returned by the list or create tools.

tools.name: memberrun_register_member_for_event
tools.title: Register a member for an event
tools.description: Register an existing member for an event. The API cannot take payment: a paid seat is refused unless payment is external (the ticket was paid on another system). Guests cannot be registered here. API: POST /event_registrations.

payment.description: Send external only when the ticket was paid on another system.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Reuse the same key only to retry the same create; the API then returns the first answer.

annotations.title: Register a member for an event

tools.name: memberrun_cancel_event_registration
tools.title: Cancel an event registration
tools.description: Cancel one registration (soft: the status becomes cancelled). The next person on the waitlist moves up if there is one. API: DELETE /event_registrations/{id}.

registration_id.description: The id, as returned by the list or create tools.
